name: Spotlight shadow sweep
what: Two lines of tilted text on a page that starts in deep shadow: a soft beam opens at the top corner and swings across while the first line's words rise in one by one, then the view jumps in and the second line rises into the middle as the beam edges keep turning slowly.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f7 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:07) the frame is in shadow; f8-f29 (00:00:00:08-00:00:00:29) a beam opens at the top right corner and its left edge swings from nearly flat to tilted the other way, decelerating, while line 1's words rise in one after another (f6-f47); f41-f48 (00:00:01:11-00:00:01:18) line 2 starts to rise in the right-hand shadow; f49 (00:00:01:19) the view jumps in about 1.19 x, line 1 is left as a clipped tail at the left edge; f49-f114 (00:00:01:19-00:00:03:24) line 2's words settle into one line while the beam edges keep turning; f115-f239 the beam almost stops, then holds

tracks.name: beam swings in
